Qt Artifacts Shipped with MyWB
==============================

This file identifies the Qt artifacts expected in the accompanying MyWB macOS
Nuitka application bundle. It covers the supported arm64 and x86_64 builds.
The release-integrity check verifies this inventory against the selected
application before distribution.

Bundled Qt version: 6.11.1

Python Binding Modules
----------------------

- PySide6/QtCore.so
- PySide6/QtGui.so
- PySide6/QtOpenGL.so
- PySide6/QtOpenGLWidgets.so
- PySide6/QtSvg.so
- PySide6/QtSvgWidgets.so
- PySide6/QtTest.so
- PySide6/QtWidgets.so

Qt Shared Libraries
-------------------

- QtCore
- QtDBus
- QtGui
- QtNetwork
- QtOpenGL
- QtOpenGLWidgets
- QtSvg
- QtSvgWidgets
- QtTest
- QtWidgets
- libpyside6.abi3.6.11.dylib
- libshiboken6.abi3.6.11.dylib

Qt Plugins
----------

Icon engines:

- PySide6/qt-plugins/iconengines/libqsvgicon.dylib

Image formats:

- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqgif.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqicns.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqico.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqjpeg.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqmacheif.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqmacjp2.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqsvg.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqtga.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqtiff.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqwbmp.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/imageformats/libqwebp.dylib

Platform plugins:

- PySide6/qt-plugins/platforms/libqcocoa.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/platforms/libqminimal.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/platforms/libqoffscreen.dylib

Styles:

- PySide6/qt-plugins/styles/libqmacstyle.dylib

TLS backends:

- PySide6/qt-plugins/tls/libqcertonlybackend.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/tls/libqopensslbackend.dylib
- PySide6/qt-plugins/tls/libqsecuretransportbackend.dylib

Not Bundled
-----------

The verified bundle does not contain Qt PDF, Qt QML, Qt Quick, Qt Virtual
Keyboard, or Qt WebEngine libraries. GNU Readline is also explicitly excluded
by the Nuitka build and its release-integrity gate.
